title: 時態
subtitle: Tenses
summary: 時態題的解法幾乎都藏在時間副詞裡。把「時間標記詞 → 時態」的對應表記熟，這一章就變成純送分。

items.en: The office opens at 8:30 every weekday.
items.zh: 辦公室每個平日八點半開門。

items.en: We launched the product in March.
items.zh: 我們在三月推出了產品。

blocks.value: 時間或條件副詞子句裡，用現在式代替未來式：When the shipment arrives（不是 will arrive）, we will notify you.
進行式 = be + V-ing，強調動作在某個時間點正在進行，或是暫時性的安排。

rows: She is reviewing the contract now.
They were negotiating when I called.
I will be attending the conference next week.

blocks.value: 狀態動詞通常不用進行式：know, believe, own, belong, contain, consist, seem, need, prefer。

items.en: We are currently updating the database.
items.zh: 我們目前正在更新資料庫。
items.note: currently 是進行式的標記詞

blocks.q: Please be quiet; the committee _____ the final candidates right now.
blocks.explain: right now 表示動作正在進行，用現在進行式。

rows: 過去到現在的累積或影響
since, for, already, yet, so far, recently
過去某時間點之前就完成
by the time, before, after, previously
未來某時間點前將完成
by next year, by the end of

blocks.value: since + 時間點（since 2020），for + 一段時間（for three years）。看到 since 幾乎一定是完成式。

items.en: The company has operated in Asia since 2015.
items.zh: 公司自 2015 年起在亞洲營運。

items.en: By the time we arrived, the meeting had ended.
items.zh: 我們抵達時，會議已經結束了。

items.en: By next Friday, the team will have completed the migration.
items.zh: 到下週五，團隊將完成移轉。

blocks.value: 現在完成式不能和明確的過去時間點連用：We have signed the contract yesterday.（錯）→ We signed the contract yesterday.

blocks.q: The firm _____ its headquarters three times since it was founded.
blocks.explain: since 引導的時間範圍延續到現在，用現在完成式。

blocks.value: 強調動作從過去持續到現在（或某時間點）且可能還會繼續，重點在「持續多久」。

items.en: We have been waiting for the approval for two weeks.
items.zh: 我們已經等待核准兩週了。

items.en: She had been working there for a decade before she resigned.
items.zh: 她辭職前已在那裡工作十年。

items.en: By June, they will have been operating the plant for five years.
items.zh: 到六月，他們營運這座廠將滿五年。

blocks.value: have been + V-ing 強調過程與持續；have + p.p. 強調結果與完成。多益若句中有 for + 一段時間且動作仍在進行，優先考慮完成進行式。

sections.title: 時態一致與時間標記詞總表

rows: ago / last… / yesterday / in + 過去年份
since / for / so far / already / recently / over the past…
by the time + 過去句 / before + 過去句
by + 未來時間 / by the end of next…
when / after / as soon as / until（副詞子句）

blocks.value: 主要子句與從屬子句的時態要相互配合：主要子句過去式，從屬子句通常也用過去相關時態。

items.en: The manager said that the shipment had already left the port.
items.note: 主句過去，從句用過去完成

items.en: As soon as the invoice is approved, we will process the payment.
items.zh: 發票一核准，我們就會處理付款。

blocks.q: The renovation _____ by the time the new tenants move in next month.
blocks.explain: by the time + 現在式（表未來），主句用未來完成式；renovation 是被完成的，用被動 will have been completed。
